206:t_1:173.en:
$$恭子$$
「Are the others coming to the closing ceremony?」

206:t_1:174.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I can't know what tomorrow will bring...」

206:t_1:175.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Hey, hey! What are you saying, $$相良$$!」

206:t_1:176.en:
$$詩織$$
「Get a grip, will you? Ten years from now, sure, but you can at least figure out what tomorrow holds, right?」

206:t_1:179.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$... I need to talk to you...」

206:t_1:181.en:
$$恭子$$
「Go on, $$カナ$$-chan. There's still time before we set up for the closing ceremony.」

206:t_1:183.en:
$$宗介$$
(What am I trying to say to $$千鳥$$...?)

206:t_1:189.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...You weren't at school, so I figured you'd be here after all...」

206:t_1:190.en:
$n
「You're one to talk, Miss $$スズネ$$. Is it all right for you to be in a place like this?」

206:t_1:191.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Getting students to go to school is part of a teacher's job, too.」

206:t_1:192.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Though that comes to an end tomorrow.」

206:t_1:194.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... Have you found closure about Nurse?」

206:t_1:197.en:
$n
「Around January this year, I'm told. I'm sure she was busy with that, and that's why she couldn't answer my e-mails either.」

206:t_1:199.en:
$n
「Apparently nobody has heard anything about that.」

206:t_1:200.en:
$n
「I heard she had been worrying herself sick over 《$$シンヤ#keyword$$》 and 《$$ミサコ#keyword$$》, so maybe that's why she quit nursing...」

206:t_1:201.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But I heard those two had recovered...」

206:t_1:204.en:
$n
「I don't think I understood anything about $$マキ#pilot$$... And I'm sure it's not only about $$マキ#pilot$$...」

206:t_1:205.en:
$n
「About my comrades in $c, and about Miss $$スズネ$$, and even about myself...」

206:t_1:206.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everybody is the same when it comes to not understanding themselves. I'm no different...」

206:t_1:208.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'll be honest with you. I'm relieved that $$マキ#pilot$$ has disappeared from your life...」

206:t_1:210.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't know why. But something inside me... is longing for you...」

206:t_1:211.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm scared, $n. There's so much I don't understand either...」

206:t_1:212.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What is this unease I keep feeling...? Is the answer somewhere even further beyond $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, whom I saw in $$ラース・バビロン$$...?」

206:t_1:214.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You must feel it too, $n. The same unease I do...」

206:t_1:215.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Tell me... Is the world... going to end?」

206:t_1:218.en:
$$傭兵$$
「If it was going to come to this, I should've just used the gun and been done with it.」

206:t_1:222.en:
$$傭兵$$
「Impossible... Faster than a gun can be drawn...」

206:t_1:224.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That was reckless! Using $$ブーストアップ$$ in a body that worn down!」

206:t_1:225.en:
$n
「I know it was dangerous... But I had no choice but to do it.」

206:t_1:226.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n... This feeling from you... It's the same as it was at $$ラース・バビロン$$...)

206:t_1:227.en:
$n
「Those guys... were definitely coming to kill us... not to capture us...」

206:t_1:228.en:
$$スズネ$$
「They came after us... is that what you're saying...」

206:t_1:229.en:
$n
「I think a method like this is the work of $$アマルガム$$...」

206:t_1:231.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$ and $$千鳥$$ are... in danger...」

206:t_1:237.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Sounds like you had a rough time. But I'm glad you came back, $$宗介$$.」

206:t_1:240.en:
$$宗介$$
「...If only the two of us could stay like this forever...」

206:t_1:243.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's not that I mind... but...」

206:t_1:247.en:
???
「...There's no need to say the words that come next, $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

206:t_1:250.en:
$$レナード$$
「Allow me to introduce myself. I'm $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$.」

206:t_1:252.en:
$$レナード$$
「Do you intend to use firearms in a sacred place of learning?」

206:t_1:253.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't screw around... you're an $$アマルガム$$ executive...!」

206:t_1:254.en:
$$宗介$$
「Raise both hands slowly, just as you are. If you refuse...」

206:t_1:255.en:
$$レナード$$
「You'll shoot me dead... right? Let's drop the usual diplomatic ritual. That kind of threat is out of date.」

206:t_1:257.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's no use, $$相良宗介$$. You seem to be quite a capable killer, but...」
